question: Which amongst the given option could be the value of the expression 2 + 2 × 2 - 3 ÷ 3 × 3 - 4 × 4 ÷ 4 = ?
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 2 + 2 × 2 - 3 ÷ 3 × 3 - 4 × 4 ÷ 4

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df943cc4170c7a296e8113b00d73088e2569bdd501160bcb77ae9722356bc09c.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ 2 + 2 × 2 - 3 ÷ 3 × 3 - 4 × 4 ÷ 4

⇒ 2 + 4 - 3 ÷ 3 × 3 - 4

⇒ 2 + 4 - 1 × 3 - 4

⇒ 2 + 4 - 3 - 4

⇒ 6 - 3 - 4

⇒ 3 - 4

⇒ -1

**The value of the expression is -1.**
